sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: The Relationships column now re-checks older answers in the background: after it has loaded from the browser's storage, the answers kept for more than 7 days are asked again, the oldest first, at most 100 per page and one a second, without any loading glyph; a row whose relationships changed is rewritten, and the progress card says how many were re-checked and how many changed. Switch: "Re-check older kept relationships in the background" (on).

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: MusicBrainz link previews: a kept answer older than "Keep MusicBrainz answers for" (24 hours) is no longer replaced by "Loading…". For up to 30 days the old card or window is shown at once, its foot saying "checking…", while MusicBrainz is asked again in the background, as majkinetor's Event Horizon does with its kept answers; if the answer changed, it repaints. A change another script reports (Event Horizon, Group Therapy, Falcon, Apollo) still drops the kept answer at once.
